title: The founding ledger's content ('I took it from his brow while he slept... and called it inheritance') is nearly word-for-word identical to what the Hollow King's own scrap of paper said back in Act 1 and what the first Reeve's shade says again in his tomb -- three near-identical repetitions of the same confession text felt like the same beat replayed rather than escalating revelation.
